title: Pattern Copy · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Pattern Copy · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner draws a short repeating pattern of circles and triangles. The lead continues the pattern for four more shapes. All four shapes follow the original repeating rule. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Pattern Copy, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All four shapes follow the original repeating rule.
recall.why: All four shapes follow the original repeating rule.
